title: Let Me Hotkey
description: Allows hotkeying items in inventories while holding an item under your cursor
body:
# Let Me Hotkey

Simple one-mixin mod that allows you to hotkey items to your hotbar while holding an item with your cursor, relieving you of a minor inconvenience you probably never knew you had.

If you need support, you can join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/A2FEXREAtQ).
